properties.name: A write is warned, not refused, when the same thing already lives in a related design, and is told where to reference it
properties.statement: When a design knows which other designs it is related to (a hub and its children, siblings under one hub, or a declared parent), writing a new requirement, decision, capability or finding also checks those related designs for the same thing. If a close match exists elsewhere, the write still succeeds, and the reply names the design and node where it already lives, so the writer can reference it there instead of keeping a second copy. ADVISORY ONLY: it never refuses, because matching across designs that use different words is not reliable enough to block on. Its false-alarm rate should be measured before anything stricter is considered. Anthony, 2026-09-22, promoting shape (a) of dec:idea-a-fact-has-one-home-across-a-family-of-designs-and-reflow2-enforces-it: the invariant has to ship in reflow2, so a hub owner (Alex at work included) never has to remember a rule.
